paragraphs: The head of the HSE says there is a big problem at Cork University Hospital. Staff there are not working well together. The HSE runs Ireland's public health service.
Anne O'Connor is the HSE chief executive. She spoke on RTÉ radio on Sunday. It was the first time she talked about the problem in public.
In August, someone secretly recorded a meeting at the hospital. Later, the recording reached the media. Many staff are now afraid. They worry that people will record them too.

In the meeting, a senior HSE manager, Andy Phillips, said the Taoiseach's office told him to speak to the hospital's boss. The Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, says this is not true. Mr Phillips has said sorry.
Ms O'Connor still trusts Mr Phillips. She wants staff to talk openly again. She says there is a lot of work to do at the hospital.

Anne O'Connor 是 HSE 的執行長。
她週日在 RTÉ 電台發言。
這是她第一次公開談論這個問題。
八月時，有人偷偷錄下醫院的一場會議。
後來，錄音流到了媒體手中。

Phillips 先生已經道歉。
O'Connor 女士仍然信任 Phillips 先生。
她希望員工能再次坦誠交談。
她說醫院還有很多工作要做。

paragraphs: The head of Ireland's health service says that staff at Cork University Hospital (CUH) are no longer working together properly. Anne O'Connor, chief executive of the HSE, made the comments on Sunday.
She was speaking on the RTÉ radio programme This Week. It was the first time she had talked in public about a row that has caused problems for the hospital and the Government.

The row began with a meeting in August between Andy Phillips, the HSE's top manager in the south-west, and senior people at the hospital. Someone recorded the meeting without telling the others, and the tape later reached the media. Ms O'Connor suggested that the recording was made illegally.

Earlier this month, The Irish Times reported that official notes of the meeting quoted Mr Phillips. He told the hospital's chief executive, Jennifer Kearney, that the offices of the Taoiseach and the Minister for Health had asked him to have certain conversations with her. The meeting came after a letter from Ms Kearney about staff shortages and patient safety was leaked.
Taoiseach Micheál Martin strongly denied that he or his staff gave any such order. Mr Phillips has since apologised fully and said no one from the Taoiseach's office had contacted him.

Ms O'Connor said she still has confidence in Mr Phillips. She said he spoke out of frustration during a difficult meeting. However, she said her main worry is that staff are now afraid of being recorded, and this stops them from speaking freely.
She said there is a lot of work to do to rebuild trust and care at the hospital. She will watch closely as plans for CUH are put in place.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭衛生服務的負責人說，科克大學醫院（CUH）的員工已無法好好合作。
HSE 執行長 Anne O'Connor 於週日發表了這番話。
她是在 RTÉ 電台節目《This Week》中發言的。
這是她首次公開談論這場為醫院和政府帶來麻煩的風波。
風波起於八月的一場會議，與會者是 HSE 西南區最高主管 Andy Phillips 及醫院的高層人員。
有人在沒告知其他人的情況下錄下會議，錄音後來流入媒體。
O'Connor 女士暗示這段錄音是非法錄製的。
本月稍早，《愛爾蘭時報》報導，官方會議紀錄引述了 Phillips 先生的話。
他告訴醫院執行長 Jennifer Kearney，總理辦公室和衛生部長辦公室要他和她進行某些談話。
這場會議是在 Kearney 女士一封談人手短缺與病人安全的信件外洩之後召開的。
總理 Micheál Martin 強烈否認他或他的幕僚下過任何這類命令。
Phillips 先生此後已全面道歉，並說總理辦公室沒有任何人聯絡過他。
O'Connor 女士說她仍然信任 Phillips 先生。
她說他是在一場艱難的會議中因沮喪而說出那些話。
不過她說，她最擔心的是員工現在害怕被錄音，這讓他們無法自由發言。
她說要在醫院重建信任與關懷，還有很多工作要做。
在 CUH 的各項計畫推行時，她會密切關注。

paragraphs: The chief executive of the HSE has said that people at Cork University Hospital (CUH) have reached a point where they are no longer working together effectively.
Anne O'Connor made the remarks on RTÉ's This Week programme on Sunday, her first public comments on a controversy that has drawn in senior health officials and the Taoiseach.

The dispute centres on a high-level meeting held in August between Andy Phillips, the HSE's regional executive officer for the south-west, and senior figures at the hospital. A recording of the conversation was later leaked, and Ms O'Connor suggested it had been made unlawfully.

Earlier this month, The Irish Times reported that official minutes quoted Mr Phillips telling the CUH chief executive, Jennifer Kearney, that he had been instructed by the offices of the Taoiseach and the Minister for Health to raise certain matters with her. The meeting followed the leak of a letter in which Ms Kearney warned that recruitment restrictions were affecting patient safety.

Taoiseach Micheál Martin firmly denied that he or his officials had issued any such instruction and questioned the accuracy of the minutes in the Dáil. However, the newspaper later obtained a tape which, it says, shows the minutes were accurate. Mr Phillips has apologised unreservedly and insists he was never contacted by the Taoiseach's office.

Ms O'Connor said she retains confidence in Mr Phillips, describing his remarks as having been made in frustration during a tense discussion. Her greater concern, she said, was that staff now fear being recorded, which prevents honest discussion.

She said the hospital's culture was not working well and that core values such as care, compassion and trust must be restored. She added that she would closely monitor the implementation of plans for CUH and the wider region.
sentZh: HSE 執行長表示，科克大學醫院（CUH）的人員已到了無法有效合作的地步。
Anne O'Connor 週日在 RTÉ 的《This Week》節目中發表上述談話，這是她首次公開評論這場牽涉衛生高層官員與總理的爭議。
爭議的核心是八月舉行的一場高層會議，與會者為 HSE 西南區區域執行長 Andy Phillips 與醫院的高層人士。
會議對話的錄音後來外洩，O'Connor 女士暗示錄音是違法取得的。
本月稍早，《愛爾蘭時報》報導，官方會議紀錄引述 Phillips 先生告訴 CUH 執行長 Jennifer Kearney，他受總理辦公室與衛生部長辦公室指示，要向她提出某些事項。
這場會議是在 Kearney 女士一封信件外洩之後舉行的，她在信中警告招聘限制正影響病人安全。
總理 Micheál Martin 堅決否認他或他的官員下達過任何這類指示，並在眾議院質疑會議紀錄的準確性。
然而，該報後來取得一段錄音，並表示錄音顯示會議紀錄是準確的。
Phillips 先生已毫無保留地道歉，並堅稱總理辦公室從未聯絡過他。
O'Connor 女士說她仍對 Phillips 先生有信心，形容他的言論是在一場緊張討論中因挫折而說出的。
她說，她更大的擔憂是員工如今害怕被錄音，這妨礙了坦誠的討論。
她說醫院的文化運作不良，關懷、同理與信任等核心價值必須恢復。
她補充說，將密切監督 CUH 及整個地區各項計畫的執行。

paragraphs: The head of the HSE has conceded that relations at Cork University Hospital (CUH) have deteriorated to the point where staff are no longer collaborating effectively.
Speaking on RTÉ's This Week on Sunday, Anne O'Connor broke her silence on a controversy that has embroiled senior health managers and even the Taoiseach.

The affair stems from a fraught meeting in August between Andy Phillips, the HSE's regional executive officer for the south-west, and the hospital's leadership. A covert recording of the exchange subsequently surfaced in the media, and Ms O'Connor intimated that it had been made unlawfully.

According to official minutes reported by The Irish Times, Mr Phillips told CUH chief executive Jennifer Kearney that the offices of the Taoiseach and the Minister for Health had directed him to broach particular issues with her. The meeting had been convened after the leak of a letter in which Ms Kearney cautioned that curbs on recruitment were jeopardising patient safety.

Micheál Martin vehemently denied any such intervention and cast doubt on the minutes in the Dáil, yet a tape later obtained by the newspaper appears to corroborate them. Mr Phillips has since apologised unreservedly, maintaining that the Taoiseach's office never approached him.

Ms O'Connor nonetheless expressed confidence in her regional chief, attributing his remarks to frustration in a heated encounter. What troubles her more, she said, is a pervasive fear among staff of being recorded, which stifles candid debate.
Acknowledging that the hospital's culture was dysfunctional, she pledged to oversee closely the plans to revive values such as compassion and trust.
sentZh: HSE 負責人坦承，科克大學醫院（CUH）內部關係已惡化到員工無法有效協作的地步。
Anne O'Connor 週日在 RTÉ 的《This Week》節目中打破沉默，談及這場將衛生高層主管甚至總理都捲入的爭議。
事件源於八月一場氣氛緊繃的會議，與會雙方是 HSE 西南區區域執行長 Andy Phillips 與醫院領導層。
這段對話的祕密錄音隨後在媒體曝光，O'Connor 女士暗示錄音是非法取得的。
根據《愛爾蘭時報》報導的官方會議紀錄，Phillips 先生告訴 CUH 執行長 Jennifer Kearney，總理辦公室與衛生部長辦公室指示他向她提出特定議題。
這場會議是在 Kearney 女士一封信件外洩後召開的，她在信中警告招聘限制正危及病人安全。
Micheál Martin 強烈否認有任何這類干預，並在眾議院對會議紀錄提出質疑，然而該報後來取得的錄音似乎證實了紀錄內容。
Phillips 先生此後已毫無保留地道歉，堅稱總理辦公室從未找過他。
儘管如此，O'Connor 女士仍表達對這位區域主管的信心，將他的言論歸因於激烈交鋒中的挫折感。
她說，更令她憂心的是員工普遍害怕被錄音，這扼殺了坦率的討論。
她承認醫院的文化運作失常，並承諾親自密切監督重振同理心與信任等價值的計畫。

paragraphs: The chief executive of the HSE has acknowledged that working relationships at Cork University Hospital (CUH) have deteriorated substantially, to the extent that staff are no longer cooperating effectively.

Anne O'Connor made these observations on RTÉ's This Week on Sunday, marking her first public intervention in a controversy that has implicated senior health administrators and, indirectly, the Taoiseach.

The dispute originated in a meeting held in August between Andy Phillips, the regional executive officer for HSE South West, and senior hospital management. A recording of the discussion was subsequently leaked, and Ms O'Connor indicated that it had been obtained illegally.

According to the official minutes, as reported by The Irish Times, Mr Phillips informed CUH chief executive Jennifer Kearney that he had been instructed by the offices of the Taoiseach and the Minister for Health to raise specific matters with her. The meeting had been prompted by the leak of a letter in which Ms Kearney argued that restrictions on recruitment were compromising patient safety.

Micheál Martin categorically denied that any such instruction had been issued and questioned the reliability of the minutes in the Dáil. Nevertheless, a recording later obtained by the newspaper reportedly confirms their accuracy. Mr Phillips has consequently apologised unreservedly, stating that he had not been contacted by the Taoiseach's office.

Ms O'Connor maintained that she had confidence in Mr Phillips, attributing his comments to frustration during a demanding exchange. She emphasised, however, that the more fundamental issue was a climate of apprehension, since staff fear being recorded, which inhibits open dialogue.
Consequently, she argued that restoring core values such as compassion and trust is essential, and she undertook to monitor the implementation of reform plans rigorously.

爭議源於八月舉行的一場會議，與會者為 HSE 西南區區域執行長 Andy Phillips 與醫院高層管理人員。
該次討論的錄音隨後外洩，O'Connor 女士表示錄音是非法取得的。
根據《愛爾蘭時報》報導的官方會議紀錄，Phillips 先生告知 CUH 執行長 Jennifer Kearney，他受總理辦公室與衛生部長辦公室指示，要向她提出特定事項。
這場會議的起因是 Kearney 女士一封信件外洩，她在信中主張招聘限制正損害病人安全。
Micheál Martin 斷然否認曾下達任何這類指示，並在眾議院質疑會議紀錄的可靠性。
然而，該報後來取得的錄音據報證實了紀錄的準確性。
Phillips 先生因此毫無保留地道歉，並表示總理辦公室並未聯絡過他。
O'Connor 女士堅稱她對 Phillips 先生有信心，將他的言論歸因於一場艱難交談中的挫折感。
不過她強調，更根本的問題在於瀰漫的不安氛圍：員工害怕被錄音，這抑制了開放的對話。
因此她主張，恢復同理心與信任等核心價值至關重要，並承諾將嚴格監督改革計畫的執行。
